text:
evan: quick note from the SDK rollout: several docs still show `max_tokens` and the old function-calling shape (`function_call`). customers hitting Dedicated are seeing errors.

rita: thanks. which pages are wrong? i can fix the migration guide and the banners.

evan: `guides/migrations/v1-to-v2.md` code blocks, `snippets/js/generate.md`, and `integrations/vector-stores/postgres.md` (embed dims).

mike: i'll patch JS + TS snippets. plan: small codemod for `max_tokens` -> `max_output_tokens` and update examples to the `tool_calls` array. will include before/after and add snippet smoke tests.

jun: i'll update vector-store docs to call out dim changes: rwd-2:1536 -> rwd-3-compat:2048 and add a reindex recipe. that's important for customers with prebuilt indexes.

rita: draft deprecation timeline: "Hosted: soft shim until 2026-07-15; Dedicated/Private: enforcement starting 2026-06-01." i'll run this by PMs and legal for wording.

evan: opened PRs: 7081 (js), 7082 (migration-guide). CI lint + smoke tests queued.

mike: added small sed snippet in PR description to help integrators: `git grep -l "max_tokens" | xargs sed -i'' -e 's/max_tokens/max_output_tokens/g'` and noted caveats for JSON keys in test fixtures.

jun: pushed vector-store fix and sample reindex script. added a red warning box about reindexing when dims mismatch.

docs-bot: PRs 7081-7083 submitted; docs build queued: https://deploys.redwood-inference.com/builds/8502. please verify anchors after changing the migration doc.

rita: once PRs merge we will add a banner, update the migration checklist, and send a short note to support + customer-success. i'll coordinate the announcement timing so it aligns with infra's maintenance window.

evan: thanks all. small follow-up: update any internal test harnesses that assert on `function_call` shape to accept `tool_calls[0]`.

(THREAD END)
